summary: On August 4, 2026, National Bank Holdings Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.32 per share on Class A common stock. The dividend is payable on September 15, 2026, to shareholders of record on August 28, 2026. The filing includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1 and states future dividends remain subject to board discretion based on financial position and capital requirements. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special-situation event such as a capital return program, tender offer, or restructuring.
